title: 水力發電調速器與水錘模擬
titleEn: Hydropower Governors and Water Hammer Modeling
subcategoryTitle: 水輪機、發電機與水力機電
subcategoryTitleEn: Hydraulic turbines, generators and hydro-mechanical systems
summary: 水輪機調速器要在水體慣性造成「反調」效應的條件下維持頻率穩定；課程定量分析水流慣性時間常數、機組慣性時間常數、永態與暫態下垂的整定，以及用特徵線法模擬水錘的時間步長選擇。
summaryEn: A hydro governor must hold frequency stable despite the non-minimum-phase effect of water inertia; the course quantifies water starting time, mechanical starting time, permanent and temporary droop settings, and the choice of time step when simulating water hammer by the method of characteristics.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.
v30Focus: 水流慣性、機組慣性與調速器參數的穩定配合
v30FocusEn: Stable matching of water inertia, unit inertia and governor settings

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：水力發電調速器與水錘模擬
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Hydropower Governors and Water Hammer Modeling
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「水流慣性時間常數」與「水頭、流量與出力」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Water starting time" and "Head, discharge and output": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「水流慣性時間常數」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Water starting time" is correct?
options: 打開導葉想增加出力時，壓力管道裡的水必須先被加速。
導葉開大，水輪機出力就立刻跟著增加。
壩越高，每一台機組的出力就一定越大。
optionsEn: When guide vanes open to raise output, the water in the pressure conduit must first be accelerated.
When guide vanes open, turbine output increases at once.
The higher the dam, the larger the output of every unit must be.
quiz.explanation: 打開導葉想增加出力時，壓力管道裡的水必須先被加速。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: When guide vanes open to raise output, the water in the pressure conduit must first be accelerated. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水流慣性時間常數：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Water starting time: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「水流慣性時間常數」如何決定「水力發電調速器與水錘模擬」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Water starting time” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Hydropower Governors and Water Hammer Modeling”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 打開導葉想增加出力時，壓力管道裡的水必須先被加速。水流慣性時間常數 T_w 表示在額定水頭作用下，把管內的水由靜止加速到額定流速所需的時間，等於各管段「長度乘流速」的總和除以重力加速度與水頭。T_w 越大，水輪機對導葉動作的反應越遲鈍，甚至出現「反調」：導葉剛開大的瞬間，水頭因加速水體而下降，出力先減少再增加。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When guide vanes open to raise output, the water in the pressure conduit must first be accelerated. Water starting time T_w is the time for rated head to accelerate the water from rest to rated velocity, the sum of length times velocity over all conduit sections divided by gravitational acceleration and head. The larger T_w, the more sluggishly the turbine responds to gate movement, even reversing at first: just as the gates open, head falls while water accelerates and output drops before it rises. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：水流慣性時間常數 T_w 一般在 0.5 至 4 s 之間
steps.observationEn: Project file: Water starting time T_w generally lies between 0.5 and 4 s
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「導葉開大，水輪機出力就立刻跟著增加。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "When guide vanes open, turbine output increases at once." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「水流慣性時間常數」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Water starting time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 打開導葉想增加出力時，壓力管道裡的水必須先被加速。水流慣性時間常數 T_w 表示在額定水頭作用下，把管內的水由靜止加速到額定流速所需的時間，等於各管段「長度乘流速」的總和除以重力加速度與水頭。T_w 越大，水輪機對導葉動作的反應越遲鈍，甚至出現「反調」：導葉剛開大的瞬間，水頭因加速水體而下降，出力先減少再增加。

Water starting time T_w is the time for rated head to accelerate the water from rest to rated velocity, the sum of length times velocity over all conduit sections divided by gravitational acceleration and head. The larger T_w, the more sluggishly the turbine responds to gate movement, even reversing at first: just as the gates open, head falls while water accelerates and output drops before it rises.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：導葉開大，水輪機出力就立刻跟著增加。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: When guide vanes open, turbine output increases at once. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 水流慣性時間常數 T_w 一般在 0.5 至 4 s 之間
knowledge.textEn: Water starting time T_w generally lies between 0.5 and 4 s

quiz.question: 依「水流慣性時間常數」的模型 T_w = L·v / (g·H)，管長 600 m、流速 5 m/s、水頭 150 m 時的水流慣性時間常數最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model T_w = L·v / (g·H) for "Water starting time", which value is closest to the water starting time for a 600 m conduit at 5 m/s and 150 m head?
quiz.explanation: T_w = L·v / (g·H)；代入 L = 600 m、v = 5 m/s、H = 150 m，得 2.04 s（管長 600 m、流速 5 m/s、水頭 150 m 時的水流慣性時間常數）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: T_w = L·v / (g·H); with L = 600 m, v = 5 m/s, H = 150 m the result is 2.04 s (water starting time for a 600 m conduit at 5 m/s and 150 m head). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 水流慣性時間常數：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Water starting time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水流慣性時間常數」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Water starting time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：T_w = L·v / (g·H)；代入 L = 600 m、v = 5 m/s、H = 150 m，得 2.04 s（管長 600 m、流速 5 m/s、水頭 150 m 時的水流慣性時間常數）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 L 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: T_w = L·v / (g·H); with L = 600 m, v = 5 m/s, H = 150 m the result is 2.04 s (water starting time for a 600 m conduit at 5 m/s and 150 m head). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise L by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：L 增加 10% 時，結果變為 2.24 s（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising L by 10% changes the result to 2.24 s (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 2.04 s（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 L 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 2.04 s (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in L with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: T_w = L·v / (g·H)；代入 L = 600 m、v = 5 m/s、H = 150 m，得 2.04 s（管長 600 m、流速 5 m/s、水頭 150 m 時的水流慣性時間常數）。
knowledge.textEn: T_w = L·v / (g·H); with L = 600 m, v = 5 m/s, H = 150 m the result is 2.04 s (water starting time for a 600 m conduit at 5 m/s and 150 m head).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: L 增加 10% 時，結果變為 2.24 s（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising L by 10% changes the result to 2.24 s (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水流慣性時間常數」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Water starting time"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
發電機轉速可以在運轉中自由調整來改變出力。
以導葉開度階躍試驗記錄出力與蝸殼壓力的響應，由初始的反向擺動幅度與時間反推實際的 T_w，與計算值比較。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Generator speed can be freely adjusted during operation to change output.
Record output and spiral-case pressure in gate step tests and back-calculate actual T_w from the size and timing of the initial reverse swing, compared with the calculated value.
quiz.explanation: 以導葉開度階躍試驗記錄出力與蝸殼壓力的響應，由初始的反向擺動幅度與時間反推實際的 T_w，與計算值比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record output and spiral-case pressure in gate step tests and back-calculate actual T_w from the size and timing of the initial reverse swing, compared with the calculated value. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 水流慣性時間常數：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Water starting time: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水流慣性時間常數」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Water starting time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以導葉開度階躍試驗記錄出力與蝸殼壓力的響應，由初始的反向擺動幅度與時間反推實際的 T_w，與計算值比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record output and spiral-case pressure in gate step tests and back-calculate actual T_w from the size and timing of the initial reverse swing, compared with the calculated value. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：水道佈置階段就要計算 T_w，超過準則時以調壓井、加大管徑或縮短壓力管道解決，而不是寄望調速器。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calculate T_w at waterway layout stage, and when it exceeds criteria fix it with a surge tank, larger conduit or shorter pressure conduit rather than relying on the governor.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：引水道很長而未設調壓井時 T_w 過大，調速器不論如何整定，孤網運轉都會出現持續的頻率振盪。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: With a long headrace and no surge tank T_w is too large, and however the governor is tuned, isolated operation shows sustained frequency oscillation. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以導葉開度階躍試驗記錄出力與蝸殼壓力的響應，由初始的反向擺動幅度與時間反推實際的 T_w，與計算值比較。
knowledge.textEn: Record output and spiral-case pressure in gate step tests and back-calculate actual T_w from the size and timing of the initial reverse swing, compared with the calculated value.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 水道佈置階段就要計算 T_w，超過準則時以調壓井、加大管徑或縮短壓力管道解決，而不是寄望調速器。
knowledge.textEn: Calculate T_w at waterway layout stage, and when it exceeds criteria fix it with a surge tank, larger conduit or shorter pressure conduit rather than relying on the governor.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC 60193 水輪機、蓄能泵與水泵水輪機模型驗收試驗。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC 60193 Hydraulic turbines, storage pumps and pump-turbines – Model acceptance tests. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「水流慣性時間常數」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Water starting time" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 引水道很長而未設調壓井時 T_w 過大，調速器不論如何整定，孤網運轉都會出現持續的頻率振盪。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
壩越高，每一台機組的出力就一定越大。
optionsEn: With a long headrace and no surge tank T_w is too large, and however the governor is tuned, isolated operation shows sustained frequency oscillation.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
The higher the dam, the larger the output of every unit must be.
quiz.explanation: 引水道很長而未設調壓井時 T_w 過大，調速器不論如何整定，孤網運轉都會出現持續的頻率振盪。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: With a long headrace and no surge tank T_w is too large, and however the governor is tuned, isolated operation shows sustained frequency oscillation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 水流慣性時間常數：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Water starting time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水流慣性時間常數」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Water starting time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 引水道很長而未設調壓井時 T_w 過大，調速器不論如何整定，孤網運轉都會出現持續的頻率振盪。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「水力發電調速器與水錘模擬」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: With a long headrace and no surge tank T_w is too large, and however the governor is tuned, isolated operation shows sustained frequency oscillation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Hydropower Governors and Water Hammer Modeling”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：T_w 越大，水輪機對導葉動作的反應越遲鈍，甚至出現「反調」：導葉剛開大的瞬間，水頭因加速水體而下降，出力先減少再增加。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The larger T_w, the more sluggishly the turbine responds to gate movement, even reversing at first: just as the gates open, head falls while water accelerates and output drops before it rises.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「導葉開大，水輪機出力就立刻跟著增加。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "When guide vanes open, turbine output increases at once." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 引水道很長而未設調壓井時 T_w 過大，調速器不論如何整定，孤網運轉都會出現持續的頻率振盪。
knowledge.textEn: With a long headrace and no surge tank T_w is too large, and however the governor is tuned, isolated operation shows sustained frequency oscillation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

knowledge.title: 工程年表
knowledge.text: 1898：Joukowsky 發表水錘基本公式
knowledge.textEn: 1898: Joukowsky published the basic water-hammer formula

quiz.question: 關於「水頭、流量與出力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Head, discharge and output" is correct?
options: 壩越高，每一台機組的出力就一定越大。
調速器的參數調得夠好，任何機組都能在孤網穩定運轉。
水輪機把水的位能轉成軸功：每秒通過的水量乘上有效落差，再扣掉水道、水輪機與發電機的損失，就是電氣出力。
optionsEn: The higher the dam, the larger the output of every unit must be.
With a well-tuned governor any unit can run stably in an isolated grid.

A hydraulic turbine converts the potential energy of water into shaft work: the water passing each second times the effective drop, less waterway, turbine and generator losses, is the electrical output.
quiz.explanation: 水輪機把水的位能轉成軸功：每秒通過的水量乘上有效落差，再扣掉水道、水輪機與發電機的損失，就是電氣出力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A hydraulic turbine converts the potential energy of water into shaft work: the water passing each second times the effective drop, less waterway, turbine and generator losses, is the electrical output. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水頭、流量與出力：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Head, discharge and output: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「水頭、流量與出力」如何決定「水力發電調速器與水錘模擬」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Head, discharge and output” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Hydropower Governors and Water Hammer Modeling”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 水輪機把水的位能轉成軸功：每秒通過的水量乘上有效落差，再扣掉水道、水輪機與發電機的損失，就是電氣出力。毛水頭是上下游水位差，淨水頭還要扣除攔污柵、進水口、壓力鋼管與尾水管的水頭損失，因此同一台機組在豐水與枯水期的出力與效率並不相同。以「水力發電調速器與水錘模擬」為例，額定水頭與額定流量是機組選型的起點，其餘尺寸、轉速與空蝕餘裕都由這兩個量推導。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A hydraulic turbine converts the potential energy of water into shaft work: the water passing each second times the effective drop, less waterway, turbine and generator losses, is the electrical output. Gross head is the level difference between headwater and tailwater; net head also deducts losses at the trash rack, intake, penstock and draft tube, so the same unit has different output and efficiency in wet and dry seasons. For Hydropower Governors and Water Hammer Modeling, rated head and rated discharge are the starting point of unit selection; runner size, speed and cavitation margin all follow from them. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：機組慣性時間常數 T_m 一般在 6 至 12 s 之間
steps.observationEn: Project file: Mechanical starting time T_m generally lies between 6 and 12 s
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「壩越高，每一台機組的出力就一定越大。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The higher the dam, the larger the output of every unit must be." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.

Gross head is the level difference between headwater and tailwater; net head also deducts losses at the trash rack, intake, penstock and draft tube, so the same unit has different output and efficiency in wet and dry seasons. For Hydropower Governors and Water Hammer Modeling, rated head and rated discharge are the starting point of unit selection; runner size, speed and cavitation margin all follow from them.

quiz.question: 依「水頭、流量與出力」的模型 P = ρ·g·Q·H·η，額定工況的單機電氣出力最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model P = ρ·g·Q·H·η for "Head, discharge and output", which value is closest to the electrical output of one unit at rated conditions?
options: 271 MW
135 MW
optionsEn: 271 MW
135 MW
quiz.explanation: P = ρ·g·Q·H·η；代入 ρ = 1000、g = 9.81、Q = 200 m³/s、H = 150 m、η = 0.92，得 271 MW（額定工況的單機電氣出力）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: P = ρ·g·Q·H·η; with ρ = 1000, g = 9.81, Q = 200 m³/s, H = 150 m, η = 0.92 the result is 271 MW (electrical output of one unit at rated conditions). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 水頭、流量與出力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Head, discharge and output: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水頭、流量與出力」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Head, discharge and output” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：P = ρ·g·Q·H·η；代入 ρ = 1000、g = 9.81、Q = 200 m³/s、H = 150 m、η = 0.92，得 271 MW（額定工況的單機電氣出力）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 H 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: P = ρ·g·Q·H·η; with ρ = 1000, g = 9.81, Q = 200 m³/s, H = 150 m, η = 0.92 the result is 271 MW (electrical output of one unit at rated conditions). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise H by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：H 增加 10% 時，結果變為 298 MW（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising H by 10% changes the result to 298 MW (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 271 MW（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 H 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 271 MW (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in H with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: P = ρ·g·Q·H·η；代入 ρ = 1000、g = 9.81、Q = 200 m³/s、H = 150 m、η = 0.92，得 271 MW（額定工況的單機電氣出力）。
knowledge.textEn: P = ρ·g·Q·H·η; with ρ = 1000, g = 9.81, Q = 200 m³/s, H = 150 m, η = 0.92 the result is 271 MW (electrical output of one unit at rated conditions).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: H 增加 10% 時，結果變為 298 MW（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising H by 10% changes the result to 298 MW (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水頭、流量與出力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Head, discharge and output"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以 IEC 60041 的現場效率試驗核對：用壓力—時間法、超音波時差法或指數法量流量，以壓力傳感器與水位計求淨水頭，以電力分析儀量發電機出力，在多個導葉開度下畫出效率曲線，與模型試驗換算值比較並標示不確定度。
水錘模擬只要把管道當成一整段剛性水柱計算就足夠了。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.

Check it with an IEC 60041 field efficiency test: measure discharge by the pressure-time, acoustic transit-time or index method, derive net head from pressure transducers and level gauges, measure generator output with a power analyser, and plot efficiency at several guide-vane openings against the scaled model-test curve with stated uncertainty.
For water-hammer simulation it is enough to treat the conduit as one rigid water column.
quiz.explanation: 以 IEC 60041 的現場效率試驗核對：用壓力—時間法、超音波時差法或指數法量流量，以壓力傳感器與水位計求淨水頭，以電力分析儀量發電機出力，在多個導葉開度下畫出效率曲線，與模型試驗換算值比較並標示不確定度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check it with an IEC 60041 field efficiency test: measure discharge by the pressure-time, acoustic transit-time or index method, derive net head from pressure transducers and level gauges, measure generator output with a power analyser, and plot efficiency at several guide-vane openings against the scaled model-test curve with stated uncertainty. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 水頭、流量與出力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Head, discharge and output: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水頭、流量與出力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Head, discharge and output” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以 IEC 60041 的現場效率試驗核對：用壓力—時間法、超音波時差法或指數法量流量，以壓力傳感器與水位計求淨水頭，以電力分析儀量發電機出力，在多個導葉開度下畫出效率曲線，與模型試驗換算值比較並標示不確定度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check it with an IEC 60041 field efficiency test: measure discharge by the pressure-time, acoustic transit-time or index method, derive net head from pressure transducers and level gauges, measure generator output with a power analyser, and plot efficiency at several guide-vane openings against the scaled model-test curve with stated uncertainty. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：驗收文件要同時列出毛水頭、各段水頭損失與淨水頭，並註明量測斷面位置；出力保證值必須綁定淨水頭與流量，而不是水庫水位。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Acceptance documents should list gross head, each head-loss component and net head with the measurement sections; guaranteed output must be tied to net head and discharge, not to reservoir level.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把壩高或毛水頭直接當成淨水頭，計算出力會高於實際；長引水道在大流量時水頭損失隨流量平方上升，機組在滿載時反而達不到額定出力，營運上表現為「水夠卻發不滿」。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using dam height or gross head as net head overstates output; in long waterways the head loss rises with the square of discharge, so the unit cannot reach rated output at full gate and the plant appears to have enough water yet cannot deliver full load. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以 IEC 60041 的現場效率試驗核對：用壓力—時間法、超音波時差法或指數法量流量，以壓力傳感器與水位計求淨水頭，以電力分析儀量發電機出力，在多個導葉開度下畫出效率曲線，與模型試驗換算值比較並標示不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: Check it with an IEC 60041 field efficiency test: measure discharge by the pressure-time, acoustic transit-time or index method, derive net head from pressure transducers and level gauges, measure generator output with a power analyser, and plot efficiency at several guide-vane openings against the scaled model-test curve with stated uncertainty.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 驗收文件要同時列出毛水頭、各段水頭損失與淨水頭，並註明量測斷面位置；出力保證值必須綁定淨水頭與流量，而不是水庫水位。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance documents should list gross head, each head-loss component and net head with the measurement sections; guaranteed output must be tied to net head and discharge, not to reservoir level.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC 60041 水力機械現場驗收試驗。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC 60041 Field acceptance tests to determine the hydraulic performance of hydraulic machines. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「水頭、流量與出力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Head, discharge and output" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把警報門檻調寬，就能解決大多數異常。
調速器的參數調得夠好，任何機組都能在孤網穩定運轉。
若把壩高或毛水頭直接當成淨水頭，計算出力會高於實際；長引水道在大流量時水頭損失隨流量平方上升，機組在滿載時反而達不到額定出力，營運上表現為「水夠卻發不滿」。
optionsEn: Widening the alarm thresholds resolves most anomalies.
With a well-tuned governor any unit can run stably in an isolated grid.
Using dam height or gross head as net head overstates output.
quiz.explanation: 若把壩高或毛水頭直接當成淨水頭，計算出力會高於實際；長引水道在大流量時水頭損失隨流量平方上升，機組在滿載時反而達不到額定出力，營運上表現為「水夠卻發不滿」。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using dam height or gross head as net head overstates output; in long waterways the head loss rises with the square of discharge, so the unit cannot reach rated output at full gate and the plant appears to have enough water yet cannot deliver full load. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 水頭、流量與出力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Head, discharge and output: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水頭、流量與出力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Head, discharge and output” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把壩高或毛水頭直接當成淨水頭，計算出力會高於實際；長引水道在大流量時水頭損失隨流量平方上升，機組在滿載時反而達不到額定出力，營運上表現為「水夠卻發不滿」。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「水力發電調速器與水錘模擬」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Using dam height or gross head as net head overstates output; in long waterways the head loss rises with the square of discharge, so the unit cannot reach rated output at full gate and the plant appears to have enough water yet cannot deliver full load. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Hydropower Governors and Water Hammer Modeling”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：以「水力發電調速器與水錘模擬」為例，額定水頭與額定流量是機組選型的起點，其餘尺寸、轉速與空蝕餘裕都由這兩個量推導。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: For Hydropower Governors and Water Hammer Modeling, rated head and rated discharge are the starting point of unit selection; runner size, speed and cavitation margin all follow from them.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「壩越高，每一台機組的出力就一定越大。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The higher the dam, the larger the output of every unit must be." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把壩高或毛水頭直接當成淨水頭，計算出力會高於實際；長引水道在大流量時水頭損失隨流量平方上升，機組在滿載時反而達不到額定出力，營運上表現為「水夠卻發不滿」。
knowledge.textEn: Using dam height or gross head as net head overstates output; in long waterways the head loss rises with the square of discharge, so the unit cannot reach rated output at full gate and the plant appears to have enough water yet cannot deliver full load.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
